source: retained development baseline; see prior replay validation
angle_method: sagittal projection in root frame: neck-hip-knee, hip-knee-ankle, knee-ankle-middle interphalangeal; geometry uses physical joint anchors; not a species-calibrated anatomical model
event_method: toe segment normal impulse summed over each 20ms interval, threshold 1e-7 N s; within-interval order and contact continuity unknown
limitations: cleared bouts are endpoint-resolved swing candidates, not proven stride events; minima can be edge-truncated and sampling can miss extrema; model toe topology differs from bird; related magpie data are not crow targets
